title: Call for Participation: AI Compute Faculty Development Initiative (2nd Cohort – 2026)
publisher: AU-ASRIC (African Union-African Scientific Research and Innovation Council)
authority_note: Primary institutional source for the programme (jointly run with BAAI and Peking University).
claims: AI Compute Faculty Development Initiative jointly implemented by AU-ASRIC, Beijing Academy of Artificial Intelligence, and Peking University
1st Cohort (April 2026) attracted over 130 applications from 24 African countries

Training covers AI systems, computing architecture (CPU/GPU/NPU), model training, open-source frameworks (FlagOS), curriculum development
draft_usage: Cited as a concrete China-Africa AI capacity-building programme under Social (Global South).
